name: Airi
source:
"Nice to meet you, my prince?"

While in his coffin, he was found by Minazuki and mistaken for a corpse. He has an inhuman beauty that makes him look like a doll. At first glance, he seems easygoing and has a tough personality, but...

He becomes interested in Minazuki, who senses death, and ends up staying at his house.

[Translated from https://x.com/aikawanemu/status/1667316577581289475]
